label: Heavy going
summary: Fear of a renewed US-Iran war deepened. Trump hinted at new strikes, Iran claimed it hit seven ships in the Strait of Hormuz, which Washington disputes, and Brent crude jumped to about $113, its highest since May. In Europe, Kyiv and its allies grew alarmed as Trump moved closer to Putin on sanctions. A magnitude 7 earthquake in Tibet killed at least 16, and Typhoon Champi shut down much of Taiwan. Police clashed with protesters in Tunisia. There was some good news. Venezuelans marched peacefully for elections, the EU gave its Sakharov Prize to the ICC, Indonesia halted a vast plantation scheme that would have cleared forest, and native wildlife rebounded on a Samoan island. The weighted formula gave 38; no editorial adjustment.
